name: RC-B10-0571/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Belarus for sending balloons and drones into Lithuania's airspace, closing airports and disrupting flights, and for pushing migrants across the border. It asks Belarus to stop these attacks and release detained European truck drivers. It calls on the EU to support Lithuania with better airspace surveillance, new counter-drone projects, and more sanctions on Belarusian officials and companies. It also criticises the United States for lifting some sanctions on Belarus without consulting the EU.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU to add sanctions and fund drone defence.
- **Who it affects:** Lithuania, European truck drivers, airlines and passengers, and Belarusian officials.
- **What happens next:** The EU Council and Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
